observational_conventions.source: IO Framework Conventions v2.0, Section 1; backward-compatible with Observational Conventions v1.0

claim_boundary.cmb_temperature: FIRAS is an imported empirical observer-side thermal datum. Paper 20 v1.8 does not count the CMB temperature as an independent prediction.
claim_boundary.r4: R4 is fixed once by Paper 17 v1.5's FIRAS uniqueness theorem and is not retuned against Paper 20 observables.
